title: The Levites Receive Cities and Pastures
description: The heads of the Levite families came to Eleazar, Joshua, and the tribal leaders at Shiloh and reminded them of the Lord's command through Moses regarding cities for them to live in. By lot, the Kohathites, Gershonites, and Merarites received a total of 48 cities with their pastures from the various tribes, including six cities of refuge for those who killed someone [ref:Joshua 21:1-42|Joshua 21:1-42].
